updates.title: Nothing can be dropped on an inactive technician, and a failed drop goes back
preconditions: You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C97010 Failed Drop") is used by this case only.
Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17701) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17702) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}, is Complete (reviewed) and has not been invoiced, so Create Invoice is offered on its Finance tab.
Approved work order {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17703) for {Customer-A} is led by technician {Technician-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta), made for this case only.
After {Work-order-3} was given its lead, {Technician-C}'s staff account was deactivated.
No technician has a shift on the Schedule for {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2} or {Work-order-3}.
On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
Read {Technician-C}'s column header and its count.
Drag {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-C}'s column and let go.
Open a second browser tab and open {Work-order-2} in it.
In the second tab, click the Finance tab and click Create Invoice.
Go back to the first tab. Do not refresh it.
Drag {Work-order-2} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-B}'s column and let go.
Read where {Work-order-2} is and the alert that appears.
Wait about ten seconds and check whether the alert is still shown.
Open {Work-order-2} and read its Lead Technician.
results: Step 3: {Technician-C}'s column is still shown with {Work-order-3}, is marked inactive and its count is 1.
Step 5: the drop is not accepted. {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column, {Technician-C}'s count stays 1 and no "Lead technician updated" message appears.

Steps 9 and 10: the move cannot be saved. {Work-order-2} goes back to {Technician-A}'s column and the alert reads "Failed to update lead technician, please try again.", with a message explaining that the work order's status does not allow the change. If the first tab already showed {Work-order-2} as locked and it could not be dragged onto {Technician-B}'s column, this part cannot be checked by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
Steps 11 and 12: the alert stays on screen until you dismiss it.
Steps 13 and 14: {Work-order-2} is in {Technician-A}'s column and its Lead Technician is still {Technician-A}.
updates.source: Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns), SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician) and SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 49 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S9-N2, S9-E1, S4-N5 (widened in version 49 from Chris Ward's answer 2 of 14 Oct 2026 to also name a technician not enrolled at this location; this case checks the inactive technician), S3-N2, S3-N4, S4-E3, S4-N3, S4-N8, S4-N2 and S4-R10, read 14 Oct 2026. The failed save is produced by invoicing the work order in a second tab before the drop lands, which replaces the earlier way of turning the network off. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version was last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026).
quotes: S3-N2
Keep matching work visible in its deactivated technician’s column.
S3-N4
Show an inactive indicator on deactivated technician columns.
S4-N5
Nothing can be dropped onto the column/group of an inactive technician (S2-N2, S3-N2) or of a technician who is not enrolled at this location (S3-R20c).
S9-N2
Apply S4-N5’s inactive-destination restriction and S4-N3/S4-N8’s failure recovery to drag reassignment.
S9-E1
If status or permission changes before a drop completes, revalidate and reject unauthorized reassignment under S4-E3/S4-N3.
S4-E3
If status becomes prohibited during a drag, reject the drop using S4-N3 and S4-N8, with a status explanation.
S4-N3
If reassignment fails, return the card or row to its original column or group.
S4-N8
Failed reassignment shows a user-dismissible alert: “Failed to update lead technician, please try again.”
S4-N2

Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced or Paid status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.
Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.
updates.stamp: Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
doc_part1: Sign in as an Owner or Admin user. On a QA site click the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". To check the permissions: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders: View and Create & Edit are on.

Pick one location for the whole case; it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (to change it: your initials > Change Location). This is {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). Create everything below at {Location-A}.
Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, with no display switcher).

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Reuse a staff member only if they are active, have Time Clock on, {Location-A} in Location and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. Otherwise click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-A}.

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Reuse a staff member only if they are active, have Time Clock on, {Location-A} in Location and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. Otherwise click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-B}.

Your initials > Settings > Staff. Create a new staff member for this case only (do not reuse a shared one, because this case changes the record): click New Staff Member and enter First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta), an Email, Role Technician, Departments Service, Location {Location-A}, turn Time Clock on, then Save & Close. This is {Technician-C}.

Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C97010 Failed Drop") > Save. This is {Customer-A}; use it for this case only. On the customer page click Contacts > New Contact > First Name and Last Name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Contact) > Save. Then Assets > New Asset > pick the contact, Year (for example 2022), Make (type "Freight" and pick Freightliner), Model (for example M2), Unit (for example TRK-118) > Save. Contact and Make are required.

Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick {Customer-A} and its asset > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form. In What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service", turn Line Approved on and click Save & Close. The status reads Approved. Write down the number shown at the top left (for example S10043-17701). Repeat this twice more. Number them {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} in the order you create them.

On the work order page pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown; it saves at once. Give {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} the lead {Technician-A}, and {Work-order-3} the lead {Technician-C}.

Complete {Work-order-2}: on its Lines tab click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, for example Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"). Then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review. The status reads Complete. Do not click Create Invoice now.
Deactivate {Technician-C}: your initials > Settings > Staff > {Technician-C}'s edit icon > click Deactivate Account and confirm.
Do not book any Schedule shift on the three work orders.

Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search with the name of {Customer-A} shows {Work-order-1} (Approved) and {Work-order-2} (Complete) led by {Technician-A}, and {Work-order-3} (Approved) led by {Technician-C}. {Work-order-2}'s Finance tab offers Create Invoice. Settings > Staff shows {Technician-C} deactivated. If anything differs, fix it before you start, then clear the search.
doc_part2: Goal: a deactivated technician {Technician-C} still leading {Work-order-3}; a Complete, not yet invoiced {Work-order-2}; then a refused drop onto {Technician-C}, and a failed move of {Work-order-2} because it is invoiced in a second tab before the drop lands.
GET /api/staff lists staff; each row has both id and staff_id, and the Schedule's staffId and the working-hours calls use staff_id.

Create {Technician-C} new for this case (never deactivate a shared technician). Create {Customer-A}, its contact and asset, and {Work-order-1} to {Work-order-3} on screen as in Part 1. Record {Work-order-1 id} to {Work-order-3 id}.

Use two pages in one Playwright browser context: page 1 holds Board View (steps 1 to 5 and 8 to 13), page 2 opens {Work-order-2} and clicks Create Invoice (steps 6 and 7). Never reload page 1 between step 7 and step 9.

UNVERIFIED on the Work Orders QA site: whether Board View refreshes a card by itself when another tab changes its status, and whether Create Invoice needs anything more on this build. If page 1 already shows {Work-order-2} locked before step 9 (it is then offered only within {Technician-A}'s column), record that and mark steps 9 and 10 as not checked by hand; do not force the request outside the screen.

Steps 9 and 10: record the network answer to the drop (the tech plan says the board move is refused only when the lead would change) and read the alert text exactly; compare it character for character with "Failed to update lead technician, please try again." Record the status explanation exactly as shown (the PRD does not give its wording).
Steps 13 and 14: confirm with GET on {Work-order-2} that the lead is still {Technician-A} and the status is Invoiced.
Context: this case follows PRD version 49 (14 Oct 2026). Nothing about how the build behaves today is assumed; judge only what you see.
Evidence: a screenshot after each step that has an expected result, the build marker, and the real value of every brace name.
updates.change_summary: Rewritten in full to the 8 Oct layout (link, Preconditions with {placeholders}, setup moved to the doc). The network-off step (Rule 114) is replaced by a by-hand route: {Work-order-2} is invoiced in a second tab while the first tab's board still shows it movable, then dragged there (S9-E1, S4-E3: rejected with S4-N3/S4-N8 and a status explanation); if the card already shows locked, the case says plainly the failed-save part cannot be checked by hand. Inactive half kept (S4-N5 v49, S3-N2, S3-N4). Own ZZAUTOTEST technician {Technician-C} is the one deactivated. Quotes re-copied from v49. Build stamp of 10/8/2026 and AUTOMATION: READY kept; this version not yet checked against a build.
